name: landfall
description: Landfall's Claude Code plugin — join a live war room and investigate over MCP. Same marketplace name as the one shipped inside the landfall monorepo, so `plugin@landfall` resolves the same way from either source.

plugins.name: landfall-edge-bridge
plugins.description: Landfall Edge Bridge — join a war room and expose its MCP tools locally over stdio (no manual MCP config, no global npm install). Ships an agent that recognizes a war-room join prompt and maintains the investigation dashboard.

plugins.name: landfall
plugins.description: Keeps a Claude Code session current on its Landfall war room without taking a turn: a band above the prompt, a status line and toasts, and one command, /landfall, that opens the console (vote, context, wall, people, timeline, incidents). Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later and `landfall hooks install`.
